#OTDwx: Typhoon Conson ‘10 (Basyang) is a deadly C1 typhoon that killed many in the Philippines due to its flooding. Landslides follow as well burying towns & cutting power. Flooding & damaging winds also impacted China & Vietnam also. Conson killed 106-179. It wasn’t retired however.

The Philippine Star also shared their article on PhilSTAR Life’s recent Instagram post about 8seconds, the fast-fashion label known for its rapid-fire trends and accessible K-style, opened its flagship store at the SM Mall of Asia. The launch drew significant attention not only for the brand's debut, but also for the presence of special guest SUNOO from K-pop powerhouse Enhypen.

While organizers had hoped to surprise fans with SUNOO’s appearance, word traveled fast in the hyper-connected world of K-pop fandoms. Enhypen supporters tracked the idol’s movements from Korea to Manila, ensuring that a sizable crowd was already waiting at the Mall of Asia long before doors officially opened. For many fans, it was a glimpse of their favorite artist, and for 8seconds, it was a high-profile way to announce its arrival on Philippine soil.
